cards.lore: Acid buffer and unable to heal. Once Acid Pranks dissolve his mineral lattice, the gate is blown wide open.
cards.power: The Acid Resist. Eddie is fit to his Acid Lacqueur, he stands ground and off into the 5.5 Critical Point.

cards.lore: Danny is alive. He builds Territory. Sends hurricanes when threatened.
cards.power: The Fluid Pulse. Transmits thermo-mechanical shocks via Hydrodynamic Theory.

cards.lore: The life support. If inflammation cuts off blood at the Apex, it undergoes ischemic necrosis.
cards.power: The Throbbing Alarm. Swelling inside hard walls causes agonizing pressure (Pulpitis).

cards.lore: His fatal weakness is the Furcation — the dark tunnel where his roots split.
cards.power: The Heavy Grinder. Handles the maximum Bite Force of the Jaw.

cards.lore: Uses Glucans to glue himself down. The scout who breaks the fortress walls.
cards.power: The Acid Fire. Eats sucrose and vomits lactic acid directly onto Eddie's face.

cards.lore: Creates an anaerobic basement where the Rod Complex can thrive in the dark.
cards.power: The Protective Slime. Builds a Biofilm Bunker blocking salves and antibiotics.

cards.lore: Uses Gingipains to shred tissue and confuse immunity, creating the chronic Periodontal Pocket.
cards.power: The Foundation Rot. Destroys the bone and ligaments, not the tooth.

cards.lore: Master of Progression — drilling deep into Danny Dentin.
cards.power: The Deep Drill. Thrives in the deep, acidic ruins after Mutans Max has opened the gate.

cards.lore: If it becomes a >4mm Periodontal Pocket, normal toothbrushes fail. It becomes a permanent insurgent base.
cards.power: The Invasion Gate. The gap between gum and tooth.

cards.lore: Thin and fragile. Stripping him away severs the tooth's connection to the world.
cards.power: The Grip. Provides the surface for Larry Ligament to hook onto the tooth.

cards.lore: Contains proprioceptors. The reason you can feel a single grain of sand.
cards.power: The Shock Absorber. Turns crushing bite forces into manageable tension.

cards.lore: Use it or lose it. If the tooth is extracted, Al shrinks (Resorption), making implants a nightmare.
cards.power: The Socket Support. The hard stone housing for the tooth.

cards.lore: Decay follows the Direction of Dentinal Rods. A dot on the surface mushrooms into a cavern inside.
cards.power: The Structural Void. The physical decay eating the tooth from the inside out.

cards.lore: Conical; doesn't stick, stays in via mechanical Undercut. Ugly but survives 40 years.
cards.power: The Silver Plug. The heavy-duty, old-school fix for back teeth.

cards.lore: Highly sensitive. If moisture sneaks in before setting, the bond fails.
cards.power: The Invisible Patch. Mimics tooth color and sets via Blue Light trigger.

cards.lore: Weaker than Connie; used as a Liner or temporary shield in high-risk zones.
cards.power: The Mineral Tanker. Sticks to wet teeth and leaks fluoride to neighbors.

cards.lore: Must reach the Apex without breaking, or becomes a permanent unwanted resident.
cards.power: The Deep Clean. Shreds the remains of Paulie Pulp and clears bacteria.

cards.lore: The Gold Standard. A Hypochlorite Accident past the apex will melt the surrounding jaw.
cards.power: The Organic Melt. Liquid bleach. Dissolves dead tissue and kills every bug.

cards.lore: Used with Sealer Cement to lock the Apex to the jawline so it can finally heal.
cards.power: The Permanent Plug. Fills the empty root canal to prevent recolonization.

cards.lore: If Felix and Nate fail, a Periapical Abscess forms here.
cards.power: The Border Control. The exit at the bottom where infection leaks into bone.

cards.lore: Creates a food trap against the molar in front, destroying two teeth for the price of one.
cards.power: The Crowding Chaos. No room to grow; pushes against the molars causing Pericoronitis.

cards.lore: Must follow Anatomical Safe Zones to avoid severing the Lingual or Mental nerves.
cards.power: The Access Opener. Slices gum and lifts it off the bone to reveal buried teeth.

cards.lore: Uses the Wheel and Axle principle so the final eviction is effortless.
cards.power: The Socket Expander. Wedges between tooth and bone to snap Larry Ligament.

cards.lore: The muscle. Last resort. If it won't budge, Frank risks snapping the Alveolar Bone.
cards.power: The Final Eviction. Grabs the tooth using Rotation and Traction to remove it forever.

cards.lore: Bone grows into his microscopic pores. Osseointegration is the miracle of dentistry.
cards.power: The Synthetic Root. Fools the bone into thinking he is part of the family.

cards.lore: Must create a Biological Seal with the gum to prevent bacteria reaching the bone.
cards.power: The Bridge Builder. Screws into Titan and sticks out of the gum to hold the Crown.

cards.lore: Implants lack Larry Ligament's blood flow defenses, so Iris destroys them faster than natural teeth.
cards.power: The Screw Loosener. Periodontitis for implants. Eats bone until Titan falls out.

cards.lore: The ultimate construction project: raising the ceiling to build a stronger floor.
cards.power: The Space Maker. Lifts the sinus floor to pack Bone Graft when Alveolar Al is too thin.

cards.lore: In a Type III, the face is detached from the skull, held on only by soft tissue — the Floating Face.
cards.power: The Midface Break. Represents classic facial breaks from massive impacts.

cards.lore: Allows for Early Function. Stress triggers Wolff's Law, making bone heal faster.
cards.power: The Bone Binder. Holds jaw-fractures together to avoid wiring the mouth shut.

cards.lore: The only joint that works in a Yoked pair. If left is sabotaged, right suffers too.
cards.power: The Click & Lock. The hinge of the jaw. If the disc slips, she clicks, pops, or locks shut.

cards.lore: Without the clot-shield, bone nerves are raw (10/10 radiating pain). Caused by smoking or straws.
cards.power: The Naked Bone Pain. Blood clot disappears, leaving bone exposed to air.

cards.lore: 5-25% are Dysplastic. If found on the tongue or floor of mouth, it's an immediate biopsy target.
cards.power: The Pre-Cancer Shadow. A white patch that might be harmless — or Squamous Sam in disguise.

cards.lore: Mutated by Cigarette Sid and Alcoholic Al until the skin rebels.
cards.power: The Tissue Destroyer. A non-healing ulcer with Rolled Borders that eats jaw and lymph nodes.

cards.lore: Not a virus; an Immune Overreaction triggered by stress or a bitten lip.
cards.power: The Stinging Nuisance. Hurts like hell for 10 days, then vanishes.

cards.lore: An Opportunist. Only takes over when Good Bacteria are dead (antibiotics) or immunity drops.
cards.power: The White Blanket. Fungus covering mouth in curds. Wiping her away causes bleeding.

cards.lore: Because of huge pulp and thin enamel, Mutans Max can reach her nerve in months, not years.
cards.power: The Placeholder. Keeps space open and guides the adult teeth into the right spot.

cards.lore: Prevents Impaction. Stops back molars from tipping forward like falling dominoes.
cards.power: The Line-Holder. Holds the gap open if Molly is evicted early.

cards.lore: Sabotages Mutans Max by messing with his enzymes. The ultimate passive-defense buff.
cards.power: The Armor Up. Replaces Hydroxyl in enamel to create Fluorapatite (harder, acid-resistant).

cards.lore: Turns a Rough Mountain into a Smooth Plain. Makes teeth cleanable, preventing 80% of kid cavities.
cards.power: The Trench Cover. Fills deep narrow cracks on molars where Sticky Sid hides.

cards.lore: Just a passenger. Does nothing until the wire is clipped in. The Interface.
cards.power: The Grip Point. Glues to the tooth to give the Archwire a handle to pull on.

cards.lore: Uses Light, Continuous Force. Pulling too hard kills Paulie Pulp or melts roots.
cards.power: The Force Planner. The wire that remembers its shape. Pushes/pulls toward a Perfect Arch.

cards.lore: Requires Elastics or Functional Appliance to pull the lower jaw forward.
cards.power: The Buck-Tooth Look. Lower jaw too far back.

cards.lore: The Habsburg Jaw Skeletal problem. If Archie can't fix him, Le Fort Leon (surgery) steps in.
cards.power: The Bulldog Bite. Lower jaw too far forward.

cards.lore: Possesses an Ester Group, helping him sink into bone better than Lidocaine.
cards.power: The Pain-Wire Cutter. Stops Sodium Channels, making the area numb for hours.

cards.lore: Combine with Antonin-Al for the Ultimate Numb, out-performing opioids for dental surgery.
cards.power: The Inflammation Fireman. The Gold Standard. Stops the Prostaglandin fire.

cards.lore: The Penicillin Alternative. Stops bacterial protein factories from working.
cards.power: The Deep-Tissue Assassin. Penetrates bone to kill anaerobic monsters hiding in Apex Ante.

cards.lore: Highly Substantive. Turns tongue brown and ruins the taste of coffee.
cards.power: The Chemical Toothbrush. Sticks to teeth and kills Sticky Sid for 12 hours.

cards.lore: A 360-degree Brace. Turns weak pieces into one strong unit to handle Multi-Root Mike's forces.
cards.power: The Structural Shield. Covers the entire tooth to prevent cracking after a massive filling or root canal.

cards.lore: A Three-Unit solution. The Anchors do double the work, risking early failure.
cards.power: The Static Fix. Replaces a missing tooth by hanging onto the two neighbors.

cards.lore: Mucosa-Borne (rests on gums). Can cause Sore Spots if she shifts.
cards.power: The Economic Crowd. Replaces multiple missing teeth with one removable device.

cards.lore: Lower Tony is a Floater with no suction, forced to balance by the tongue and cheeks.
cards.power: The Complete Reset. Uses Atmospheric Pressure (suction) to stay on the palate.

cards.lore: If you can't see the Lamina Dura (white line around the root), the foundation is failing.
cards.power: The Shadow Hunter. Sees what is hidden: the dark Caris decay or the Ante infection in bone.

cards.lore: 400,000 RPM, water-cooled. Clear decay without cooking the pulp.
cards.power: The Precision Purge. High speed for the shell, low speed for the rot. Clear decay without cooking the pulp.

cards.lore: Name the nerve, classify the impaction, and justify the extraction. No guessing. Stay fluffy!
cards.power: The Pimp-Master.

cards.lore: Q1: Paulie Pulp → File-Felix. Q2: Wisdom-Willy → Scalpel Stan. Q3: Porphy-Pete → Sulcus Sam. Q4: Dry-Socket Dan.
cards.power: The Clinical Application Matrix. Q1. Throbbing Night / Q2. Sideways Squeeze / Q3. Wobbly Foundation / Q4. Post-Extraction Fire.
